💊 Drug Spotlight: Glimepiride (Amaryl)

Glimepiride is a sulfonylurea used to lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.

🔹 Use: Type 2 diabetes
💊 Form: Oral tablet
🧬 Action: Stimulates the pancreas to release more insulin.

⚠️ Key Risks: Hypoglycemia and weight gain.

💡 Clinical Pearl: Glimepiride is usually taken once daily with breakfast or the first main meal. Skipping meals can increase the risk of low blood sugar.
